payout_quote: DB Plasma official new-donor offers on its provider-owned subdomains (site.dbplasma.com): Akron and Bloomington - 'Earn $200' 'In 2 Visits' 'Donating Plasma' with '*** Exclusive Offer: Offer only valid for new donors on their first and second donations' (Akron) / 'Offer only valid for new donors' (Bloomington). Jackson - 'Earn $100' 'In 1 Day' '*** Exclusive Offer: Offer only valid for new donors on their first donation.' Standing schedule on dbplasma.com/donors/compensation/: 'You will receive up to $100 per donation' plus a bonus for the second donation when donating twice in one calendar week (Monday-Sunday).
steps: Go to DB Plasma's official site and pick your location (e.g. Akron OH, Bloomington IL, Jackson TN, Harrisburg PA); new-donor offers vary by center.
Complete the new-donor qualification process: questionnaire, interview, medical examination and testing on two separate occasions.
Donate as a new donor; the exclusive offer applies to your first donation (Jackson: $100 in 1 day) or first and second donations (Akron/Bloomington: $200 in 2 visits).
After qualification, you become a qualified donor able to donate up to twice every 7 days; ongoing pay is 'up to $100 per donation' with a second-visit-of-the-week bonus.
Compensation is loaded on your payment card, typically within a day of donation.
catches: You must pass medical screening on two separate occasions to qualify as a donor; not everyone qualifies.

The new-donor exclusive offer applies only to the first (or first and second) donation(s); ongoing donations pay 'up to $100 per donation' with a weekly bonus, so earnings vary by center location and donation frequency.
Donating twice a week is required to maximize pay; each visit takes roughly 90-150 minutes.
Offers vary by center location; confirm the current new-donor offer at your center before donating.
Eligibility: 18-69, 110-400 lbs, no tattoo or piercing in past 4 months, no blood donation in past 56 days.
